column1: # Ant head, full-face view: measurements and indices of Hita Garcia & Fisher (Tetramorium revisions) on the Descriptron frontal-head
# landmark template (17 Nov 2026): 1/2 and 3/4 posterior/anterior eye extremes (image-left eye, image-right eye), 5/6 and 7/8 outer/inner
# eye margins opposite each other, 9 posterior head margin on the midline, 10 anterior clypeal margin on the midline, 11/12 head sides at
# the maximum width directly behind the eyes, 13 apex of the frontal triangle, 14/15 highest points of the posterior margin either side.
# Scape length (SL, SI) needs scape landmarks (colour images; not in the CT template).

column4: head length: anterior clypeal margin to posterior head margin, on the midline
head width: maximum width directly behind the eyes, across the midline
head width across the eyes (outer eye margins), across the midline
eye length (maximum diameter along the midline), mean of both eyes
eye width (outer to inner margin), mean of both eyes
vertexal impression depth: midline point of the posterior margin behind the line 14-15 (+ = impressed)
posterior margin to the apex of the frontal triangle, along the midline
cephalic index with the width across the eyes
